sentences.text: Caroline Blakiston -LRB- born 13 February 1933 -RRB- is an English actress .

She is best known in her native United Kingdom for her role in the television comedy series Brass , and to international audiences as Mon Mothma in the Star Wars film Return of the Jedi .	Brass	Brass (TV series)	Mon Mothma	Mon Mothma	Star Wars	Star Wars	Return of the Jedi	Return of the Jedi
